definitions.explanation: The short, thick first digit of the human hand.
The innermost and usually largest toe of the foot (when context is clear).

examples.english: I gave a thumbs up as a sign of approval.

notes:
USAGE: {親指|おやゆび} literally means 'parent finger' - the largest finger that 'leads' the others.

FINGER NAMES:
- {親指|おやゆび} - thumb (parent finger)
- ⟦{人差|ひとさ}し{指|ゆび}→人差し指：11471_hitosashiyubi⟧ - index finger (pointing finger)
- ⟦{中指|なかゆび}→中指：04281_nakayubi⟧ - middle finger
- ⟦{薬指|くすりゆび}→薬指：16373_kusuriyubi⟧ - ring finger (medicine finger)
- ⟦{小指|こゆび}→小指：04029_koyubi⟧ - pinky (small finger)

FOR BIG TOE:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{親指|おやゆび} - big toe (when disambiguation needed)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {親指|おやゆび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ - to give a thumbs up
